name: kiln
title: Kiln
description: A potter's glaze test board: every product is a raw-clay test tile on a nail, its top third dipped in one celadon glaze, the price written on the glaze in iron-oxide brown, the category scratched below, on grey speckled stoneware.

tokens.--font-round: the rounded face: headings, the shop's name, prices, product names, phone and e-mail, bold text
tokens.--font-mono: the scratched codes: category, status, details, opening hours, small labels, dates, code
tokens.--tracking-code: letter spacing of the small mono capitals
tokens.--price-size: largest size of the price on a tile
tokens.--color-bg: page background: the stoneware ground, also behind code in page text
tokens.--color-speckle: the iron specks in the ground and under the glaze
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, the shop's name, the menu, product names
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dates, quotes, page numbers, the footer, a sold-out tile's name and description
tokens.--color-accent: links, the line under product names and the current menu item, list bullets, focus rings
tokens.--color-line: the rules under the masthead and above the footer, and between the home page's opening hours
tokens.--color-clay: raw clay: tiles, the slabs under page text, the undipped end of the how-to-order card
tokens.--color-clay-edge: the lower edge that gives clay its thickness, the line and hole rim of unfired glaze, thin rules on clay: details, hours, tables
tokens.--color-incise: codes scratched in clay: category, status, details, small labels; the sold-out plate
tokens.--color-incise-light: the light caught under each scratched letter
tokens.--color-glaze: the celadon fill: the dipped end of every tile and of the how-to-order card, selected text
tokens.--color-glaze-pool: deeper celadon where glaze gathers: the bead along the dip line, the run, the rim of the nail hole
tokens.--color-glaze-ink: everything written on glaze: price and unit, the how-to-order text, phone and e-mail
tokens.--color-glaze-raw: the chalky unfired glaze of a sold-out tile
tokens.--color-nail: the nail head in each hole and the shade around it
tokens.--shadow-tile: the hard, short shadow under tiles and the how-to-order card
tokens.--shadow-hole: the shading inside a nail hole
tokens.--tile: narrowest a tile may be before a row drops a column
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of slabs, images and code blocks, and of one corner of each hand-cut tile
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between a label and its value
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between a name and its description
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens, padding of slabs, gap between tiles
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks and between rows of tiles
tokens.--space-5: large gap: above the how-to-order card
